relay.skills.tray.label.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.skills.json at bfa3df2ac). Accessible name of the list of skills docked above the message field while the user types a $name. The noun 'skills' as the product names them; no punctuation.

relay.skills.tray.hidden.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.skills.json at bfa3df2ac). Small tag on a skill row whose author marked it as not offered automatically (frontmatter 'hide'); the skill is still listed because the user typed its name. One lowercase word, no punctuation.

relay.skills.skipped.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.skills.json at bfa3df2ac). Notice after a message was sent: the listed skills had no content to attach, so the message went without them. {names} is a comma-separated list of $-prefixed skill names (technical tokens, never translated); {count} is how many. The message WAS sent.

relay.skills.too_large.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.skills.json at bfa3df2ac). Error under the message field: the skills named in the draft are too large to send together, so nothing was sent and the draft is kept. States the remedy: remove one skill and send again.
